audience.text: Developers building .NET applications that need fast, lightweight image format detection and header probing without full decoding or heavy dependencies.

capabilities.text: Detects image format from file headers using signature matching and format-specific handlers.
capabilities.title: Format detection

capabilities.text: Reads dimensions, bit depth, and frame count directly from image headers without pixel decoding.
capabilities.title: Header property extraction

capabilities.text: Parses DICOM Implicit VR Little Endian and Explicit VR Little/Big Endian transfer syntaxes, extracting metadata up to pixel data.
capabilities.title: DICOM support

capabilities.text: Reports page count and dimensions for multi-page formats like DjVu (DJVM) and AVIF/HEIC via container structures.
capabilities.title: Multi-page format support

capabilities.text: Returns partial ImageInfo instead of throwing when headers are malformed or truncated.
capabilities.title: Robust error handling

capabilities.text: Supports adding new formats by implementing IFormatHandler and registering it in ImageProbe.
capabilities.title: Extensible format support

limitations.text: Does not decode, edit, or convert images — only detects format and reads header properties.
DICOM parsing stops if it encounters a sequence or encapsulated pixel data with undefined length before finding Rows/Columns/BitsAllocated.
CDR format support is planned but not yet implemented.

problems_solved.text: Enables format detection and dimension extraction for rare or complex formats like DICOM, PSD, EMF/WMF, and DjVu without full decoding.
Avoids the overhead of full image decoding when only metadata such as format, dimensions, bit depth, and frame count are needed.
Provides a unified .NET FOSS interface for probing formats that other libraries do not support, such as DICOM and EMF/WMF.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Imaging.Foss is a zero-dependency .NET library for detecting image formats and reading basic header properties without decoding pixels.

uncertainties: Whether net8.0 is officially supported despite the target_framework fact only specifying netstandard2.0.
Exact list of all supported formats beyond those explicitly mentioned in the README.
Whether the library supports reading color space or ICC profile information from headers.

workflows.name: Build from source
workflows.text: Clone the repository and build the project using dotnet build on the Aspose.Imaging.Foss.csproj file.

workflows.name: Run tests
workflows.text: Execute tests located in the tests/ directory as part of the build process.

workflows.name: CI validation
workflows.text: Continuous integration workflows defined in .github/workflows/ validate changes before merging.
